supportSubtitle: Find quick answers below or reach our team for order and delivery help.
supportHours: We typically respond within a few hours, 9 AM – 9 PM IST.
faqOrderTrackQ: Where is my order or why is delivery delayed?
faqOrderTrackA: Open My Orders from your profile to see status. Delays can happen due to weather, traffic, or store prep time. If it is much later than expected, contact us with your order ID.
faqWrongItemsQ: I received wrong or missing items
faqWrongItemsA: Tell us within 24 hours of delivery with your order ID and photos if possible. We will work with the store to replace items or arrange a refund where applicable.
faqRefundQ: How do refunds and cancellations work?
faqRefundA: If the store has not started preparing your order, cancellation may be possible from support. Refunds for eligible issues are processed to your original payment method within 5–7 business days.
faqPaymentQ: Payment failed or I was charged twice
faqPaymentA: Failed payments are usually not captured. If money was debited but the order did not confirm, wait 24–48 hours for auto-reversal or email us with transaction details.
faqCouponQ: My coupon code is not working
faqCouponA: Check expiry, minimum order value, and store eligibility. Enter the code on the cart screen before checkout. Promo codes from banners must match the offer terms.
faqAddressQ: How do I update my delivery address?
faqAddressA: Go to Saved Addresses in your profile to add, edit, or set a default address. For an active order, contact support — the address may not be changeable after dispatch.
